drafted_from: workflow:keep-the-proof-sessions-signed-in's own file, tools/workflows/recipes/keep-the-proof-sessions-signed-in.json (its wake every-morning and four steps), and tools/check-every-screen-at-every-width/proof-accounts.json.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep my proof accounts signed in for the live screen check." The AI switches on workflow:keep-the-proof-sessions-signed-in's wake every-morning.
no_lists_because: The sessions and the codes are vault values (proof-sessions, proof-sign-in-code), never rows; the proof accounts are the Workshop DATA proof-accounts.json.
instructions: 1. The vault owner puts proof-sessions and proof-sign-in-code once, each bound to the sites' hosts (a run never creates a name or widens its hosts).
2. Switch on the wake every-morning of workflow:keep-the-proof-sessions-signed-in.
3. Each morning at 9 AM CST it reads when each session ends; only when one ends within renew_when_days_left does it ask the sites for codes, keep them in the vault, and sign in with them.
4. Read the result with tool:read-when-the-proof-session-ends: each origin's expires_at and days_left, and renew.

worked_examples.title: Renew the proof sessions once, by hand
worked_examples.ask: Renew my proof accounts' sign-ins now
worked_examples.answer: Codes asked for both accounts; then keep and sign run in turn.
worked_examples.hands_back: Steps ask, keep and sign answered at 3:01:09-3:01:22 PM CST Nov 21 2026; tool:read-when-the-proof-session-ends then read both ends as Nov 28 3:01 PM CST, renew false.
